propositions: Step 7's sibling sweep does not declare confirmed siblings as reviewable scope on the bug ticket, so fixes are never reviewed as a design for the class family.
The plan-review hook for blast-radius escalation exists but Step 7 does not reference it, leaving non-test-code changes unescalated when multiple siblings are discovered.
Plan-review-gate.md contradicts the shipped blast-radius escalation by claiming bugs are never BLOCKED, requiring documentation correction and addition of the escalation exception.
Step 7 must route confirmed siblings through the full plan-review rubric by recording file impact and cross-referencing the Phase-1 exit-gate directive, not restating it.
Sibling discovery must be portable across trackers: rebar command names must be conditioned on tracker type with a generic equivalent stated for non-rebar projects.
